openproject-apikey-help: You can find your API token in your account settings in OpenProject.
apihelp-openproject-close-summary: Close a work package in OpenProject (and its parent, if no open children are left).
apihelp-openproject-close-param-id: ID of the work package to close.
openproject-api-nokey: No OpenProject API token set. Please add it in your preferences.
openproject-api-unauthenticated: OpenProject rejected your API token. Please check it in your preferences.
openproject-api-conflict: The work package was changed in the meantime. Please reload the page and try again.
